We completely understand your frustrations regarding outstanding bugs and wanted to reassure you that we are committed to continuing development on Tormented Souls 2 in 2026. Following the release of the ‘New Game Plus’ update on 12th February we have been investigating a number of new issues alongside historic bugs, and so we wanted to give you a quick update on our plans for patches in the coming weeks and months.
Today we’re soft launching the 1.4.1.3 patch on a public beta branch. This patch includes the following bug fixes:

We’ve got some great news to share as we’ve just launched a major FREE update for Tormented Souls 2!

Centred around a challenging ‘New Game Plus’ mode, additional content includes tougher enemies, deadly new weapons, more secrets, and even a bonus costume for Caroline! Read on to find out what’s in store…
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541046/03ae4f1ec397c1e3ce9fddfc7865d95073fcb874.gif"]

Unlocked immediately after completing the game for the first time, ‘New Game Plus’ ratchets up the tension by increasing both the enemy count and adding even more jumpscares! Fortunately for Caroline, this mode also introduces two new weapons. The ‘Electric Lance’ is an experimental device that delivers a lethal shock at close-range, while the highly volatile ‘Flamethrower’ sets Caroline’s enemies ablaze in spectacular fashion!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541046/fb68adb39c3a23c75204df652a0fc1b3d3346a6a.gif"]

While playing through ‘New Game Plus’, Caroline should keep a close eye out for ‘Nuclear Batteries’. These twelve collectable items are scattered across Villa Hess, and rumour has it that collecting them all will unlock the secret of the strange mechanical device that has mysteriously appeared in front of the town’s ruined Train Station. But there’s more! By achieving the ‘true’ ending of ‘New Game Plus’ players will be treated to a special ending that pays homage to the series’ classic survival horror roots.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541046/f6500dcb10414df34f158519b7b10f62357e13a6.gif"]

To reflect the challenge of the mode, Caroline can now unlock a ‘New Game Plus’ specific bonus costume, which really emphasises her excellent ‘bone structure’. Players will find this fun outfit in the wardrobe of the Convent Guest Room after completing a 'New Game Plus' run-through (on any difficulty) where they have also solved the nuclear batteries puzzle and obtained the 'true ending'.
This new content is also now live on all platforms 😎

items.text: 2025 was an amazing year for us having reached the incredible milestone of over 100,000 units sold within the first 6 weeks of release! We even picked up some award nominations in the process including:

Best Latin American Indie at the The Indie Game Awards
Horror Game of the Year at the LATAM Indie Awards
Standout release at the Latin American Games Showcase: The Game Awards Edition

To celebrate everything that Tormented Souls 2 accomplished thanks to your support we've released an ‘Accolades Trailer’ showcasing Caroline at her finest, set against the epic end-credits track ‘Open Your Heart’ by series composer NyxTheShield.

Thank you for your patience as we worked through all of your feedback and bug reports over the past few weeks 🙏 Following a short beta period we have now rolled out patch 1.3.2 which should address over 60 issues including the softlocks that have been frustrating players since launch.
IMPORTANT: During the beta period we were made aware of two instances of persisting softlocks in 1.3.2:
Issue 1: Sometimes the main cemetery (tomb dials) puzzle does not trigger correctly after it is completed.

Solution: Ensure that you save in the Cemetery Office immediately after entering the cemetery area for the first time. If you encounter the softlock issue reloading the Cemetery Office save should clear the bug.
Issue 2: In rare instances, fuse items placed in the School Generator Room or held in the players inventory in v1.2 are disappearing in v1.3.2. We are investigating why this is happening.
Solution: For some players collecting the fuse items from the fuse box and saving in v1.2 before switching over to v1.3.2 resolves the issue.
As an extra precaution we are keeping the v1.2 of the game live on a separate public beta branch so that players can revert to this version if need be. You can access the branch as follows:
1. Right click on the Tormented Souls 2 app in your Steam library.
2. Select ‘properties’.
3. Select ‘betas’ from the left-hand menu.
4. Click on the ‘beta participation’ dropdown and select ‘rollback_1.2.0'
5. Select ‘installed files’ from the left-hand menu and click ‘verify integrity of game files’.

We’re just checking in to give you a quick update on the Steam demo version of Tormented Souls 2. Since launching a few weeks back over 27,000 players have now experienced this special demo edition, which is truly staggering! Naturally with so many of you playing, we’ve received A LOT of feedback which we have been reviewing and discussing as a team.
Today, we’re releasing the 1.0.2 patch for the demo which addresses several of the bigger pain points that the community has raised, please read on for a full list of what we have changed.
Added Type C control scheme.
Improved Anna's character model.
Increased radius size of interaction points.
Improved the animation of the lighter being equipped when coming off a ladder.
Fixed issue with physics on the elevator.
Several fixes to facial animations.
Improved melee weapon system on breakable objects.
Removed collision from breakable objects.
Added breakables on staircase at Belltower to decrease backtracking.
Added a new hint for the Cryptex puzzle.
Updated cable colour for electrical panel in Prison
Redesigned puzzle for electrical panel.
Added the ability to pick up the electrical panel puzzle hint.
Added zoom in/out feature on Map for Controller
Improved performance throughout.
Fixed an issue where occasionally players would get into a softlock when dashing with Hammer and switching instantly to the Nailer.
Fixed an issue where the Cryptex puzzle where the mesh would separate from the puzzle.
Fixed an issue where players will be stuck in auto aiming when switching from the Lighter to the Nailer.
Fixed issue with corrupted map in Jailer room.
Fixed a bug where you could attack an enemy before the jump scare.
Fixed an issue where the shortcut menu will not work when coming off a ladder.
Fixed a crash when loading auto save in Basement and then entering South Corridor 1F
Fixed issue with FPS dropping when opening the Map.
Thanks for all the feedback and support, we’ll endeavour to address as much as possible before the final release this year, and we’ll be back with more updates over the coming months.
Dual Effect and PQube.
